name: TES Tube
tagline: YouTube-style video and Shorts platform for Turon Ecosystem
role: Web app, shared monorepo and CI/CD for Turon Ecosystem

scenes.title: Long videos and Shorts
scenes.body: One server-rendered Next.js 16 app serves both, so every watch and channel URL can be indexed.

scenes.title: Adaptive HLS playback
scenes.body: hls.js plays the HLS bitrate ladder and picks the right quality automatically.

scenes.title: Shorts with comments
scenes.body: A full-height vertical player with likes, sharing and one-level reply threads beside the video.

scenes.title: Channel tabs
scenes.body: Tabs for videos, Shorts, past broadcasts, playlists and About, each at its own crawlable URL.

scenes.title: Responsive to 360px
scenes.body: Touch layouts and bottom sheets on phones; 592 layout boxes are checked against the Figma file within 1.5px.
